summary: A teachers' strike ends with a deal barring punishment of tenured strikers and barring strikers from harassing co-workers who worked.
realLife: In Middletown Township, New Jersey, in 1998, the board had voted to fire nontenured staff who stayed out, then rehired them with two frozen years of pay as part of the settlement.
sources: Education Week, N.J. Teachers Return to Classroom After Strike: https://www.edweek.org/teaching-learning/n-j-teachers-return-to-classroom-after-strike/1998/09
inGame: a protest or strike formed by the public-action engine ends; job records of strikers and non-strikers continue; coworker ties between them change.

turns.summary: Staff go back to work and stay civil.
Strikers and non-strikers avoid each other.
A few transfer to another district.
